policy: Deterministic source-preserving import. Never infer authority, PASS or relations from prose. All imported objects start Draft/revision 1. Explicit mappings below; unmatched documents become Evidence of source existence with immutable source copies. Execution tasks remain source material, never another Product type.
missingSection: Preserve as source Evidence, report unmapped Product content; do not fabricate a canonical section
sourceCopies: migration-sources/<SHA256(raw bytes)>.<original suffix>; excluded from normative state except explicit sourceRefs
